title: Input fields with inline validation messages
when: The user wants form fields that show helpful error messages next to the field while typing or on submit.
prompt:
Goal: Validation that tells people how to fix each field, at the right moment, in a way screen readers announce. Steps: 1. Rules as native constraints (required, type, minlength, pattern); add novalidate to the form and run checkValidity() in JS to show your own messages. 2. Validate a field first on blur; once it was invalid, revalidate on every input so the error clears as soon as it is fixed. 3. Each field gets

linked through aria-describedby together with its hint, and aria-invalid="true" while wrong. 4. Messages say how to fix it: Enter an email like name@example.com, not Invalid. 5. On submit with errors, prevent it, show a role="alert" summary with links to the fields and focus the first invalid one. 6. Show success in a role="status" region. Quality bar: - Errors pair an icon and text with the red border. - No error shows before the user touched the field. - Messages are set with textContent. Pitfalls: - Validating on every keystroke from the first letter. - Clearing what the user typed after an error. - Disabling the submit button with no explanation. Verify: - [ ] Every field has a label and an error element linked by aria-describedby. - [ ] aria-invalid toggles with the state. - [ ] Submit focuses the first invalid field. - [ ] A live region announces the result. Output: Form markup, validation styles in form.css and validate.js.

examples.input: validar email e senha mostrando o erro embaixo do campo
examples.output: blur then input validation, aria-describedby error text, role alert summary on submit, focus first invalid
